 This Petition, Coming On For Final Hearing, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 -3-
 Nc: 2024:Khc:20553
 Crl.P No. 6526 of 2022
 Order

The petitioners are before this Court seeking the following prayer:
" PRAYER WHEREFORE, the Petitioners most respectfully pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the Impugned Order dated 08.06.2022 at Annexure D passed by the Learned Civil Judge and JMFC, K R Pet, Mandya in C.C.No.713 of 2022 for the offence punishable under Section 143,498A, 304B read with 149 of IPC and read with Section 6 of DP Act and pass such other order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice and equity"
2. Learned Additional State Public Prosecutor on instructions would submit that accused Nos.1, 3 to 6 have all been acquitted of the offences alleged against them.
A split up charge sheet is issued against accused No.2, as he has not available for trial.

3. In that light, reserving liberty to accused No.2 to challenge the said split up charge sheet before the appropriate fora, the petition stands disposed, recording the fact that NC: 2024:KHC:20553 accused Nos.1 and 3 to 6 have all been acquitted of the offences.
